title: Adic formal smoothness over a field makes base-field differentials injective at the residue field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $(C,\mathfrak m,K)$ a Noetherian local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with residue field $K=C/\mathfrak m$. Assume $C$ is formally smooth over $k$ for its $\mathfrak m$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. For the modules of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], the $K$-linear map $\Omega_{k/\mathbf Z}\otimes_k K\to\Omega_{C/\mathbf Z}\otimes_C K$ induced by $k\to C$ is injective. (In characteristic $p$ these modules identify with the differentials relative to $\mathbf F_p$; in characteristic zero the map remains injective after composing with the map to $\Omega_{K/\mathbf Z}$.)
